jobs.tierReason: owner order: Opus grades the Command Center design each round
jobs.prompt:
Grade round 3 of the Swarm Command Center. You are an independent design grader. Read ONLY the files in your context.
The four PNGs are real screenshots of the running app against live board data: Hive (all projects) and Cockpit (one project), each at 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 phone.
The approved target design is the static mockup: docs/design/command-center-mockup/hive.html, cockpit.html and shared.css (read their markup and CSS; you cannot render them).
Score each page 0.0-5.0 in steps of 0.1 on this rubric, then give an overall per page (the mean, one decimal):
1 layout: grid, alignment, spacing, nothing overlapping, clipped or stacked down one edge; 2 hierarchy: what matters first is biggest/brightest, readable type scale; 3 data clarity: numbers and states are legible and labelled, empty states make sense; 4 fidelity: matches the mockup's look (header, tiles, cards, colours, rules); 5 phone: single column, no overlap, tap targets, nothing cut off; 6 polish: consistent radii, borders, colour use, no debug text or stray UI (e.g. a tour panel covering content).
5.0 = indistinguishable in quality from a top product dashboard and faithful to the mockup; 4.5 = ship-ready with small nits; 3.0 = mockup-level parity but rough; 1.0 = unstyled or broken.
Then list the top fixes per page (at most 6 each, most impactful first). Each fix: the visible problem, where on screen, the likely file (tools/watch-assets/cc-hive.css, cc-hive-mount.js, hive-panels.js for Hive; cc-cockpit.css, cc-cockpit-mount.js, cockpit-view.js, cockpit-lists.js for Cockpit) and a concrete CSS or markup change. Do not suggest hard-coded sample data.
Write ONLY coordination/review/cc-grade/r3/grade.json as JSON: {"round":3,"hive":{"scores":{"layout":n,"hierarchy":n,"data":n,"fidelity":n,"phone":n,"polish":n},"overall":n,"fixes":[{"problem":"","where":"","file":"","change":""}]},"cockpit":{same shape},"notes":"one or two sentences"}.
